readback.name: Poincare.GroundedTopologyUniversalSourceStatement
readback.mathematical_statement: This is a proposition definition parameterized by one arbitrary universe u. It asserts that every M:Type u with its supplied topology, Hausdorffness, a charted-space structure over real Euclidean 3-space, simple connectivity and compactness admits a GroundedTopologyPresentation on the same topological space. The presentation chooses a possibly different ChartedSpace atlas and a GroundedTopologySource under that chosen atlas; it does not assert that every ambient topological atlas is differentiable. The source is a Type(u+1) record carrying a legacy finite-extinction proposition, a certified finite component decomposition, a traceStage:Type u, an actual package-backed trace, and a Perelman production source indexed by the exact trace-selected package's flow. The legacy extinction proposition alone only stores a nonempty certificate of named proposition/proof fields; it is not by itself a literal geometric extinction theorem. The retained trace instead stores the selected smooth C1 structure, analytic/surgery package, its aggregate surgery source and flow equality, a nonempty finite event prefix indexed by Fin(terminalEventIndex+1), actual event times/regions from that package, nonempty finite active sets with disjointness, parent-child agreement away from each event, terminal agreement with the fixed decomposition and empty event regions beyond the prefix. Every represented event region is nonempty, so a zero-event source is not furnished by this interface. Its active sets are subsets of the original M, not changing physical surviving manifolds. Component carriers have a map into M and membership/witness data but no required carrier topology, connectedness, continuous or injective embedding, surjectivity onto the component set, or homeomorphism. The Perelman source ties its classification and Ricci-norm high-curvature pointed rescalings to the same flow and payload chain; the threshold condition is norm(Ricci)>=a positive threshold. No field identifies the trace's event regions with those high-curvature regions or identifies that implemented Ricci norm with full Riemann curvature. The proposition asserts existence of all these records, but its declaration merely has type Prop and supplies no proof of that existence, spherical covering, or final recognition.

readback.name: Poincare.GroundedTopologyThreeSphereCoveringStatement
readback.mathematical_statement: This is a proposition definition in the same arbitrary universe u. For every compact simply connected Hausdorff M:Type u carrying a charted atlas over real Euclidean 3-space, and for every supplied GroundedTopologySource M under that atlas, it requires existence of a map p:ThreeSphere->M satisfying Mathlib IsCoveringMap. ThreeSphere is the unit metric sphere in real Euclidean 4-space. IsCoveringMap means that each target point has an evenly covered neighborhood with discrete fiber; its abstract definition permits empty fibers and does not include a separate surjectivity field. The surrounding connected/nonempty topological hypotheses may support further conclusions, but those are not separately asserted by this definition. The complete concrete source, including selected package/flow/decomposition/trace/Perelman chain, is an argument. The literal type contains no additional compatibility equation describing how p is assembled from its necks, caps, component carriers or trace; it also does not force proof dependence on those fields. This universal reconstruction/covering obligation is conditional on a supplied source and does not itself produce sources or a homeomorphism.

readback.name: Poincare.GroundedTopologySource.active_components_cover
readback.mathematical_statement: For one universe u, every M:Type u with topology, Hausdorffness, a charted structure over real Euclidean 3-space, simple connectivity and compactness, every supplied source:GroundedTopologySource M, and every stage:source.traceStage, the union of source.trace.activeComponentSet stage component over all component indices at that stage equals Set.univ in the original M. Its dependent stage and component-index types come from the source. This is a set-cover statement at every recorded stage, including the terminal stage. It does not assert physical nonextinction, a partition of a changing time-slice manifold, connectedness/openness of the sets, topological embeddings of their carriers, neck/cap gluing, or sphere recognition. It assumes the whole package-backed source and does not prove universal source existence.

readback.name: Poincare.GroundedTopologySource.unique_active_component
readback.mathematical_statement: For one universe u, every M:Type u with the same topology/Hausdorff/charted/simple-connectivity/compactness instances, every supplied source:GroundedTopologySource M, every stage:source.traceStage and every x:M, there exists exactly one index component:source.trace.activeComponentIndex stage such that x belongs to source.trace.activeComponentSet stage component. Uniqueness is equality of indices in this supplied stage family. Combined with the cover statement, this describes a disjoint set partition of the original M. The name component does not add connectedness, manifold structure or any continuous/injective carrier map. The assertion applies also at the terminal recorded stage, so it must not be read as saying the physical post-extinction surviving slice is nonempty. It constructs no source, flow, surgery realization or spherical covering.

readback.name: Poincare.poincare_statement_of_groundedTopologySources_and_covering
readback.mathematical_statement: For one arbitrary universe u, this is the implication GroundedTopologyUniversalSourceStatement.{u}->GroundedTopologyThreeSphereCoveringStatement.{u}->PoincareConjectureStatement.{u}. If both universal source existence and the universal covering obligation for every supplied source are given, the conclusion is that every compact simply connected Hausdorff topological M:Type u charted over real Euclidean 3-space has a nonempty type of homeomorphisms M~=ThreeSphere. The source premise permits selecting a replacement compatible atlas over the same topology before invoking the source-dependent covering premise. The conclusion has no extra chosen-source, surgery, smoothness or flow premise at each M beyond those two universal hypotheses. This is conditional assembly: it proves neither hypothesis, supplies no independent smoothing/Hamilton/Perelman existence result and is not the reserved unconditional Poincare endpoint. Approval here concerns the literal assertion and pinned definitions only. The snapshot digest was independently recomputed and all eight definition/config hashes matched the actual isolated Lean4.33 checkout; no assembly proof, intended author report or earlier blind review was read, and no compilation, axiom acceptance or Lean source edit was performed.
